name: Shadowed Mask
source:
Three years ago your first case was assigned to you, a beginner detective. “Which real criminal in their right mind would give a warning notice in this day and age? It must be a kid pulling a prank!” However, at that time, no one could predict that this case, which seemed to come straight from a detective novel, would become a world-wide threat with international coverage.

And just like that you’ve become the most known detective around the globe, working on the most accompanied case ever registered. So now you’ve got to live up to their expectations and catch the infamous phantom thief Midnight.

But remember, the rising pressure can’t lead you to give up and most definitely don’t fall for that heartless bastard.

[From [url=https://rosewoodailin.itch.io/shadowed-mask-midnight-route-demo]itch.io[/url]]
